inc_mhra_ck.name: inc_mhra_ck
inc_mhra_ck.value: not "incidents"."reported_to_mhra" or ("incidents"."yellow_card_ref" is not null and "incidents"."reported_to_mhra_at" is not null)

le_scanner_ck.name: le_scanner_ck
le_scanner_ck.value: "location_events"."source" not in ('scan', 'manual') or "location_events"."scanned_by_id" is not null

tti_limits_ck.name: tti_limits_ck
tti_limits_ck.value: "test_template_items"."kind" = 'check' or "test_template_items"."lower_limit" is not null or "test_template_items"."upper_limit" is not null

wo_completed_ck.name: wo_completed_ck
wo_completed_ck.value: "work_orders"."status" <> 'completed' or ("work_orders"."completed_at" is not null and "work_orders"."outcome" is not null)
